_comment: Material-UI v4 -> MUI v7 import mapping. Data only – codemod-mui-imports.js reads it. manual messages are shown to the user verbatim.

@material-ui/lab.review: @mui/lab is not declared in package.json and lab components changed between versions – check manually

@material-ui/pickers.review: The @mui/x-date-pickers API differs from @material-ui/pickers (LocalizationProvider, adapter, component names) – needs manual review

@material-ui/styles.manual: @material-ui/styles has no target in MUI v7. makeStyles is converted by codemod-makestyles; withStyles, createStyles and StylesProvider need manual conversion

manual.makeStyles: makeStyles is converted by codemod-makestyles (instances that depend on props are left there for manual handling)
manual.withStyles: withStyles is not supported in MUI v7. Needs manual conversion to styled() or sx
manual.createStyles: createStyles is not supported in MUI v7. Inside makeStyles it is removed by codemod-makestyles; any other usage needs manual conversion to styled() or sx
manual.StylesProvider: StylesProvider is not supported in MUI v7. Needs manual conversion – usually removal, or StyledEngineProvider with injectFirst if it was used to control CSS load order
manual.Hidden: Hidden was removed in v5 – needs a semantic conversion (useMediaQuery / sx display)
manual.withWidth: withWidth was removed in v5 – needs a semantic conversion (useMediaQuery)
